scenarios.name: Use consistent spacing within and between workspace regions

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon, model browser, viewport, document tabs and status area are visible
the user inspects the spacing between workspace regions and their controls
adjacent workspace regions share their intended borders without stray gutters
controls within each region use a consistent inset from that region's border
the ribbon command groups use even spacing between neighboring groups
the browser, viewport, document tabs and status area align to their shared edges
no region has an unexplained extra margin or padding
